note: Only explicit human approvals and rejections become exemplars. A provider failure is not automatically a creative failure — no Seedance render may create a rule here.

exemplars.userWords: re-fired for a stronger in-flight read
exemplars.principle: an opening frame must already carry the shot's motion — body pitched into travel, never a figure hovering at rest

exemplars.attempted: Fuzzby horizontal, chest leading, legs trailing; Zenny poised on a petal
exemplars.principle: contrast in one frame: his momentum against her stillness reads as story before a single frame moves

exemplars.attempted: one 15-second take carrying chase + crash + deadpan + settle with 21 negatives
exemplars.userWords: the full internal production contract was being treated as the provider prompt
exemplars.principle: creativity happens upstream; the performer receives a lean brief with room to act — never the whole contract

exemplars.attempted: 'the pose itself becomes the joke' shipped as direction
exemplars.userWords: one proposed replacement expressed entirely through visible character movement, pose, expression and timing
exemplars.principle: abstract intent is planning language; the storyboard's shipped direction is observable behaviour with timing

exemplars.where: Ep1 Scene 1 — complete Authoritative Storyboard Package (creative-room process v1), archived unchanged at cb-output/creative/archive_process_v1/Ep1_scene1_storyboard.json
exemplars.attempted: 5 beats / 16 shots / 8 voice performances; per-beat three-interpretation exploration with the Cinematographer authoring camera after the Director's selection
exemplars.userWords: Process-level failure — correcting its camera instructions or shot cards manually would paper over that failure: (1) the Cinematographer entered after the dramatic approach was already selected; (2) the scene lacked a governing audience-experience and visual-grammar decision; (3) fixed left/right staging returned; (4) action -> consequence -> reaction coverage repeated across the scene; (5) the opening camera anticipated the crash from a safe position instead of discovering the action experientially; (6) mandatory shot-field completion encouraged over-direction and conventional coverage.
exemplars.principle: Cinematography is a co-author of the scene's dramatic approach, never a decorator of a finished one. A scene needs ONE governing audience-experience and visual-grammar decision before beats or shots exist. No fixed screen lanes; no automatic action/consequence/reaction coverage; the camera discovers action experientially rather than waiting for it from safety; a schema box is never a reason to direct.
exemplars.cinematography: whole-scene visual grammar decided with (not after) the dramatic approach; reaction shots only when the reaction changes meaning

exemplars.where: cb_director/SKILL.md runtime contract + CLAUDE.md rules 71-78 (the checklist-verb failure family)
exemplars.attempted: beat/shot action text stacking independently-clocked verbs — 'flies in, clips a stem, tumbles, lands' — to convey energy
exemplars.userWords: reads as disconnected events to a video model, not one continuous motion
exemplars.principle: ground physical action in ONE cause with two-or-three chained, visible consequences — never a checklist of independent actions, which reads as disconnected events, not continuous motion

exemplars.attempted: an image-prompt instruction ('write it as plain, observable description, never poetic language') proposed as a flat rule with no scope statement
exemplars.principle: state image prompts as plain, observable description, never poetic metaphor — but this governs REGISTER only, always additive to the reference/identity rules, never a replacement for them
exemplars.cinematography: concrete over poetic, additive to the identity/reference rules, never a substitute for them

exemplars.where: CLAUDE.md rules 4/29 (Law 5) + skills/crystal-bears-composer/SKILL.md's now-flagged stale reference, 2026-07-19
exemplars.attempted: a post-generation identity-swap on sung/spoken vocal output (strip native audio, then re-voice via an external voice-changer pass)
exemplars.userWords: no native-voice fallback; no post voice swap; cb_post has no swap function by design — do not add one
exemplars.principle: the voice lives IN the render — one supplied @Audio1 track, lip-synced at generation time; a failed voice track REFUSES the render, it never falls back to a native voice or gets swapped in after the fact
exemplars.voice: one supplied @Audio1 track only, generation-time, never post; a failed voice track REFUSES the render rather than substituting a native or swapped voice

exemplars.where: PIPELINE_CUTOVER_LEDGER.md §11, "THE MISFIRE" — real $0.144 billed Scene Look Plate generation, 2026-07-19
exemplars.attempted: firing a generation call whose fallback content path (an empty canon file) had nothing real to anchor on, so the model received almost no real content and invented an unrelated image
exemplars.userWords: a known failure mode for an image-edit model given no real content to anchor on
exemplars.principle: a thin or generic fallback must never silently substitute for real, approved content on a billed call — refuse and name what's missing, never degrade quietly and ship what the model invents
exemplars.cinematography: never submit a generation prompt built from an empty/fallback content source without an explicit approval gate in front of it

exemplars.attempted: building, documenting, and testing a hard-refusal safety check in isolation, without verifying it was actually called from the real content-generation entry points
exemplars.userWords: zero call sites anywhere in cb_render.py
exemplars.principle: a check that exists and is documented is not the same as a check that is wired in — verify real call sites, not just that the code exists, before trusting a safety mechanism is live
